ChessboardAdvancedTuning.description:
Advanced, **unstable** per-stage tuning knobs for the chessboard detector.

Behind `ChessboardParams::advanced`. The
knobs are named after the live topological pipeline stages. The defaults are
chosen to hold the detector's precision-by-construction contract — a
calibration consumer has no basis to set any of them and should leave the
whole struct at `Default`. Tune a knob only when a specific input fails and
you have evidence for the change.

**NOT covered by semver.** These knobs are named after, and coupled to,
internal pipeline stages; they may be **renamed, retyped, or removed
between minor versions** without a major-version bump. Do not depend on the
field set being stable. The stable configuration contract lives entirely on
`ChessboardParams`'s three top-level fields.

When set on `ChessboardParams` via
`with_advanced`, the whole struct
serializes under a nested `"advanced"` JSON object — the knobs are not
flattened. When left unset, the serialized config carries no `"advanced"`
key and detection behaves exactly as if every knob held its `Default`
value (see `ChessboardParams::effective_tuning`).

attach_ambiguity_factor.description:
Ambiguity factor: if the second-nearest candidate is within
`factor × nearest_distance`, the attachment is skipped.

attach_axis_tol_deg.description: Axis alignment tolerance at attachment time (degrees).

attach_search_rel.description:
Candidate-search radius (fraction of `s`) around a predicted `(i, j)`
when the booster attaches a corner to an empty cell.

cluster_sigma_k.description:
Multiplier on the per-corner axis sigma added to `cluster_tol_deg`
when admitting a corner. Default `0.0`: sigma-aware tolerance is
plumbed through but disabled. Set to e.g. `2.0` (a ≈95% one-sided
confidence band) to pass corners whose true axis is within tolerance
but whose ChESS estimate fell outside under noise.

`cluster_tol_deg`: ChessboardAdvancedTuning::cluster_tol_deg

cluster_tol_deg.description:
Per-axis absolute tolerance (degrees) for a corner's axis to count as
matching a cluster center. The effective per-corner gate is
`cluster_tol_deg + cluster_sigma_k * max(σ_a0, σ_a1)`, so noisier
axis estimates get proportional slack — see `cluster_sigma_k`.

`cluster_sigma_k`: ChessboardAdvancedTuning::cluster_sigma_k

component_merge.description:
Tuning knobs for the shared local-geometry component merger that
reunites the topological grid's connected components in label space.

edge_axis_tol_deg.description: Edge axis-direction tolerance (degrees) enforced at admission time.

enable_final_edge_shape_check.description:
Enable the final local edge-shape gate (the direct topological
wrong-label check: interior skipped-corner edges and duplicate-pixel
labels).

Default `true` for direct chessboard detection. Downstream
target-specific detectors with their own geometry/ID alignment gates
(e.g. ChArUco) may disable it to preserve recall.

enable_geometry_only_recovery.description:
Enable a final, geometry-only rescue for strong corners whose measured
axes failed clustering.

This pass is deliberately narrower than the axis-aware booster: it
requires an L-shaped set of three already-labelled neighbours and does
not let recovered corners support further recovery. It exists for the
case where the image-space corner position is reliable but the local
orientation fit is not.

enable_weak_cluster_rescue.description:
Enable the weak-cluster rescue booster: re-admit corners that
clustered only within the looser `weak_cluster_tol_deg`.

geometry_check_line_tol_rel.description:
Line-collinearity tolerance (fraction of cell_size) for the MANDATORY
final geometry check that runs before any detection is emitted. Loose
by design — the geometry check's role is to catch gross mislabels
(diagonal / full-cell shifts), not the borderline perspective drift the
grid builder already accepted.

Default `0.45` of cell_size. A tight tolerance here produces
catastrophic recall regressions on heavy-radial-distortion boards.

geometry_check_local_h_tol_rel.description:
Local-H residual tolerance (fraction of cell_size) for the MANDATORY
final geometry check. A diagonal mislabel shifts a corner by ~1.4 cell
from its predicted position; `0.6 × cell_size` is well below that gap
while leaving the legitimate perspective-distorted corners alone.

Default `0.6` of cell_size.

geometry_recovery_tol_rel.description:
Maximum geometry-only prediction residual and candidate-search radius,
as a fraction of the local cell size.

line_min_members.description:
Minimum members required to fit a line / column for the geometry
check's collinearity test.

max_booster_iters.description: Cap on the outer booster loop.

max_iters_2means.description: Max 2-means refinement iterations over axis votes.

min_peak_weight_fraction.description:
Minimal fraction of total axis-vote weight required for a peak to be
considered.

num_bins.description: Number of histogram bins on `[0, π)` for axis-direction clustering.

peak_min_separation_deg.description:
Minimal angular separation (degrees) between the two peaks. Guards
against seed-peak collisions; true grid axes are `~90°` apart.

step_tol.description:
Edge-length window (fraction of `s`) enforced when admitting edges
from a newly-attached corner to its labelled neighbours.

topological.description:
Tuning knobs for the topological (Delaunay + axis-driven cell test)
grid builder — the only graph builder the detector ships.

validate_step_aware.description:
When `true`, the geometry check's tolerances are multiplied by a
per-corner local step (computed from labelled grid neighbours) instead
of the global cell size. Anisotropic thresholds catch outliers in
dense (perspective-foreshortened) regions that a global threshold would
miss, and stay loose in distorted regions where the local cell pitch
grows.

Default `false`: the capability is shipped without changing behaviour.
Enabling it currently drops one labelled corner on
`testdata/puzzleboard_reference/example1.png` (the tighter back-edge
tolerance over-flags), so treat it as a focused per-dataset experiment
until a tuned tolerance pair holds the precision contract on every
blessed image. Set to `true` to opt in.

weak_cluster_tol_deg.description:
Cluster tolerance for "weakly clustered" corners eligible as recall-
booster candidates. Must be ≥ `cluster_tol_deg`.

cell_size_ratio_tol.description:
Cell-size agreement tolerance: `|s_p - s_q| / max(s_p, s_q)` must
be ≤ this value to even attempt a merge. Default: `0.20`.

max_components.description: Upper bound on returned components after merging. Default: `4`.

min_overlap.description:
Minimum number of overlapping labels (after candidate alignment)
for a merge to be accepted. Default: `2`.

position_tol_rel.description:
Position tolerance for accepting two corners as the same physical
point, expressed as a fraction of the mean per-component cell
size in pixels. Default: `0.20`.

TopologicalParams.description:
Tuning knobs for the axis-driven topological pipeline.

Defaults are conservative values pinned by the crate's regression tests.
Adding new fields is non-breaking via `#[non_exhaustive]`;
literal-construction from outside the crate goes through `default`
+ struct-update syntax or `new`.

axis_align_tol_rad.description:
Maximum angular distance, in radians, between an edge's
direction and a corner's axis for the edge to classify as a
grid edge at that corner. Default: 15° = 0.262 rad.

axis_cluster_centers.description:
Optional global grid-direction centers, in radians, interpreted
modulo π. When `Some([θ₀, θ₁])`, a feature is admitted to
Delaunay only if at least one of its informative axes is within
`cluster_axis_tol_rad` of one of the centers. When
`None`, the gate is skipped.

cluster_axis_tol_rad.description:
Per-axis admission tolerance against
`axis_cluster_centers`, in radians. Only consulted when
`axis_cluster_centers.is_some()`. Default: `16° = 0.279`.

edge_length_max_rel.description:
Upper bound on a quad's perimeter edge length, expressed as a
fraction of the per-component median quad edge length. Quads
with any edge longer than `edge_length_max_rel * component_median`
are rejected as "above local cell scale" (typically a quad formed
across a missing corner). Default: `2.5`. Set to `+inf` to
disable the upper bound entirely (JSON has no infinity: pass a very
large finite value such as `1e30` instead).

edge_length_min_rel.description:
Lower bound on a quad's perimeter edge length, expressed as a
fraction of the per-component median quad edge length. Quads
with any edge shorter than `edge_length_min_rel * component_median`
are rejected as "below local cell scale". Default: `0.4`.
Set to `0.0` to disable the lower bound entirely.

max_axis_sigma_rad.description:
Maximum 1σ axis uncertainty (radians) for a feature axis to be
considered informative. Features whose both axes have
`sigma_rad ≥ max_axis_sigma_rad` are excluded from Delaunay;
classification skips individual axes above the threshold.
Default: `0.6 ≈ 34°`. `sigma_rad = None` is treated as informative.

min_corners_for_component.description:
Discard labelled components with fewer than this many corners.
Default: `4` (one quad of four corners).

min_quads_per_component.description:
Discard connected quad-mesh components below this size. Default:
`1` (keep all). Set higher to reject isolated noise quads.

opposing_edge_ratio_max.description:
Reject quads whose opposing edges differ in length by more than
this factor (paper's parallelogram test). Default: `1.5`.

description: Chessboard detector configuration: a stable core of three knobs (`min_labeled_corners`, `max_components`, `min_corner_strength`) plus an opt-in, unstable `advanced` block of per-stage tuning knobs that is not covered by semver. Omit `advanced` to keep the precision-by-construction defaults.

advanced.description:
Opt-in, **unstable** per-stage tuning knobs. Leave unset (`None`)
unless a specific input fails and you have evidence for the change;
`None` behaves exactly like `ChessboardAdvancedTuning::default()`. Set via
`with_advanced`. See `ChessboardAdvancedTuning` — its
fields are NOT covered by semver.

Serialized under a nested `"advanced"` object when `Some`, and omitted
entirely when `None`.

max_components.description:
Maximum number of components returned by `ChessboardDetector::detect_all`.

A chessboard can split into multiple disconnected pieces on ChArUco
scenes where markers break contiguity. Each iteration peels off one
grown grid from the unconsumed corners and re-runs seed → grow →
validate. Default `3` (`ChessboardParams::default`); a **required** key
in a serialized config.

Does NOT claim to support scenes with two separate physical boards —
one target per frame is the contract.

min_corner_strength.description:
Minimum corner strength (ChESS response) for the Stage-1 pre-filter.
Corners with `strength < min_corner_strength` are dropped before
clustering. `0.0` disables the filter.

**Default `33.0`.** A defocused board edge (or marker-bit saddle)
fires the ChESS detector weakly — strength ≈ 15–30 against a sharp
board's ≈ 90+ — and such corners, while grid-consistent in position,
are low-confidence and pollute the labelled frontier with a ragged,
noisy row that is unhelpful for calibration. A `33.0` floor removes
that weak frontier; sharp boards (whose every corner clears the
floor) are unaffected. The value matches the ChArUco detector's floor
(`CharucoParams::for_board`), so the chessboard and ChArUco grid
builds now start from the same corner set — set this to `0.0`
explicitly to recover the previous maximum-recall behaviour.

Part of the stable configuration core. A **required** key in a
serialized config (top-level `min_corner_strength`).

min_labeled_corners.description:
Minimum labelled corners for a
`ChessboardDetection` to be emitted.
Default `8` (`ChessboardParams::default`); a **required** key in a
serialized config.
